## Appearance

In her youth, she was skinny with freckles, a small pointed chin, and prominent red braids that she once accidentally dyed green. As she matures into adulthood, her gray-green eyes retain their sparkle, and her hair remains bright and long. By the time she is a mother of many, she still maintains a girlish grace and flushed cheeks.

_Sources: [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c15 P32](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0032), [v1 c27 P16](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0016), [v3 c25 P35](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0035), [v5 c1 P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003)_

## Personality

Anne is an imaginative, passionate, and romantic individual with a deep love for nature and vivid storytelling. She possesses a fiery temper when provoked about her looks or values, but she matures into a loving, humorous, and empathetic woman. She values deep emotional connections, excels at forming lasting friendships, and holds a strict sense of duty and responsibility.

_Sources: [v1 c9 P15](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0015), [v1 c11 P25](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0025), [v1 c20 P26](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0026), [v3 c2 P3](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0003), [v4 c30 P27](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0027), [v4 c30 P28](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0028)_

## History

Anne Shirley was born in Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia, but was orphaned in infancy when her parents died of fever. At eleven years old, she was brought to Prince Edward Island to live at Green Gables with Marilla and Matthew Cuthbert, who had originally intended to adopt a boy. Despite early mishaps caused by her fiery temper and wild imagination, she quickly won the affection of her foster parents and community. She formed a deep bond with her best friend Diana Barry and maintained a fierce academic rivalry with Gilbert Blythe throughout her school years at Avonlea and Queen's Academy. After graduating from Queen's, she taught at Avonlea School and later pursued higher education at Redmond College in Kingsport, where she published short stories. Upon finishing her degree, she married Gilbert Blythe, moved to Four Winds, and eventually settled at Ingleside as a mother of six children.

_Sources: [v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v1 c6 P14](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0014), [v1 c9 P15](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0015), [v1 c15 P35](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0035), [v1 c15 P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 c35 P7](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0007), [v1 c36 P7](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0007), [v2 c6 P3](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0003), [v3 c5 P7](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0007), [v3 c21 P7](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0007), [v3 c36 P3](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0003), [v4 c1 P0](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0000), [v4 c3 P42](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0042), [v5 c1 P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003)_

## Background by volume

- Born in Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia to high school teacher Walter Shirley and Bertha Shirley  <sub>[v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011)</sub>
- Orphaned as an infant when both parents died of fever  <sub>[v3 c21 P7](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0007)</sub>
- Adopted by mistake by Matthew and Marilla Cuthbert of Green Gables  <sub>[v1 c6 P14](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0014), [v1 c12 P15](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0015)</sub>
- Attended Avonlea School, Queen's Academy, and Redmond College  <sub>[v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031), [v1 c36 P3](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0003), [v3 c5 P7](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0007)</sub>

## Quotes

> I was eleven last March. And I was born in Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia. My father’s name was Walter Shirley, and he was a teacher in the Bolingbroke High School. My mother’s name was Bertha Shirley.  <sub>[v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011)</sub>

> You mean, hateful boy! How dare you!  <sub>[v1 c15 P37](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0037)</sub>

> I’m not an orphan any longer. I feel as if I had opened a book and found roses of yesterday, sweet and beloved, between its leaves.  <sub>[v3 c21 P22](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0022)</sub>

> I am your friend and you are mine, for always. Such a friend as I never had before.  <sub>[v4 c21 P48](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0048)</sub>
